name: Micro USB socket
summary: The small flat port used on older phones and cheap dev boards. Needs an 8 x 3.2 mm panel slot.
source: The Micro-B plug shell is 6.85 x 1.8 mm, which is fixed by the USB Micro-B specification. The rest is not verified: the 8.0 x 3.2 mm cutout is a working opening with clearance added by hand, and the socket body is a generic surface-mount receptacle whose depth and height vary between suppliers. The plug's moulded body is roughly 11 x 6.5 mm, much larger than the shell, so the socket must sit right at the panel face on a thin panel or the plug will not push in far enough to latch.

keepouts.label: Room for the plug and cable

electrical.note: The connector itself is rated around 1.8 A. A plain USB 2.0 host only supplies 500 mA unless it is a dedicated charging port.
